values.meaning: Heal scaling with target's missing health (1% per 0.95% missing health, cap at 100% missing health for max heal)
values.quote: {{pp|label1=target's '''missing''' health|label=Heal increase|key=%|0 to 100 for 11|key1=%|0 to 95|formula=1% per 0.95% of target's '''missing''' health}}
values.binNote: The wiki's stated scaling (1% heal increase per 0.95% missing health, i.e. coefficient ~1.0526) cannot be derived from MaxHealThreshold=0.05 or MaxHealMult=1.0 as printed; these two data values do not by themselves encode the 1/0.95 slope shown in the tooltip formula (they likely feed a hidden curve/threshold not exposed in the sheet). Reporting the wiki's number as a disagreement rather than altering it to match the bin.

mechanics.claim: The bonus attack speed persists through Cougar Form when cast on herself.
mechanics.quote: The {{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}} will persist through {{ai|Aspect of the Cougar 2|Nidalee|Cougar Form}} if '''Nidalee''' uses ''Primal Surge'' on herself.

mechanics.claim: Swipe deals damage to all enemies hit in an arc, chosen at cast start, and can be blocked by a spell shield.
mechanics.quote: slashes in an arc in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit

mechanics.claim: Swipe's targets are picked at cast start, before the visual effect plays.
